consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if any Pilot configuration remains in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Pilot related configuration from the static configuration.

original.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3bf592e4e8] says Pilot configuration "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", and its remediation is to remove all Pilot configuration from the static configuration. That is a stated failure: Traefik itself won't run, so an action-eligible kind fits. workload-failure works because the running proxy breaks. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence's wording.
